description: Re-baseline a jig corpus onto a moved load-bearing reference by drafting a keystone ADR and an affected-artifact disposition manifest. Use when a vendor/API contract moved and specs and decisions must be re-anchored. Auto-triggers when you say reframe onto this, we changed direction, the design moved, or re-baseline the project; invoke explicitly as `/jig:reframe`. Defers to any other installed skill whose description identifies it as handling project re-baselining or migrating onto a new reference. Does not defer to the generic built-in. Do not use for adopting jig (use `/jig:migrate`), cleanup against a fixed reference (use `jig:refactor`), changing one decision (use `adr.py supersede`), or cross-artifact drift detection (use `/jig:analyze`).
